habit.description: Often jumps the moment she gets up from a knockdown. Meet her in the air or walk under the jump and punish the landing.

notes: Kitsune aggressive (Y2): Foxfire at mid range while advancing. Habit 70% and tell_cover 0 so a tester can name it in 2-3 fights (demo tier). Light kick and heavy kick are not referenced yet: add to close-range pokes once their retakes land. Kit ids from YOK-45 (PR #38); in the harness P2 still shares Ryo's kit so non-habit moves are not exercised there.
